The Supervisor of Elections results page for the 2019 Duval First Election shows Lenny Curry with a majority of the mayoral vote (84,604 of 146,817). Jacksonville Code Sec. 350.102(a) says a candidate with a majority in the first consolidated government election is declared elected, and a general election is held only if no candidate has a majority. The 2019 Duval General Election page lists only council contests and no mayoral contest. The decisive election was the first election on March 19, 2019.
